message:
Last summer, I was cozy on the couch watching a lovely storm roll in, when my phone decided it was the perfect moment to take a long nap. I thought, "Great, just what I need—no weather updates, no calls, and the cat’s already hiding under the bed!" 

After a quick search for a backup plan, I found my trusty old radio buried in a drawer. It was like finding an old friend—reliable and full of news when I needed it most. 

Now, I keep that little radio handy, just in case my tech decides to ghost me again. 

What’s your go-to backup for those tech-meltdown moments?
